description: The pie chart presents the distribution of math problems across topic-and-level categories, showing 12 slices in total, each labeled with a percentage and count. The slices are: Algebra – Olympiad-level (dark blue) at 21.19% (82); Algebra – High School (pink) at 17.83% (69); Pre-Calculus – High School (brown) at 14.21% (55); Combinatorics – Olympiad-level (light green) at 9.56% (37); Geometry – Olympiad-level (light orange) at 6.46% (25); Linear Algebra and Abstract Algebra – University-level (magenta) at 6.46% (25); Calculus and Analysis – University-level (gray) at 6.20% (24); Probability – University-level (teal) at 5.43% (21); Statistics – University-level (light cyan) at 4.39% (17); Differential Equations – University-level (yellow-green) at 3.62% (14); Geometry – High School (light purple) at 3.62% (14); and an unlabeled Olympiad-level category (light gray) at 1.03% (4). There is no separate legend; instead, labels with leader lines are placed outside the pie, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
